leadText: Lucien Dodge is an American voice actor for the English-language dub of and other Pokémon animation. He is currently affiliated with VOX Inc.
plainText:
Lucien Dodge is an American voice actor for the English-language dub of and other Pokémon animation. He is currently affiliated with VOX Inc.

==Biography==
Dodge was born in Ithaca, New York, and became a voice actor as an adult. He began to provide voices for when and TAJ Productions took over the dubbing and distribution of the series. His most prominent roles are that of Chili and .

Dodge is one out of only two voice actors to have worked on , Pokémon Origins, and Pokémon Generations, the other being Cristina Vee.
